name: @devdigest/agent-runner
description: SPEC-05 Export to CI — the CLI that runs inside a target repo's own GitHub Actions workflow. Reads the pull_request event + .devdigest/ config, calls @devdigest/reviewer-core's reviewPullRequest (never reimplements it), writes devdigest-result.json, optionally posts a GitHub review/comment, and exits non-zero when the agent's ci_fail_on gate trips. No workspace tooling (per root CLAUDE.md) — own package.json/lockfile, consumes reviewer-core/src via a tsconfig path alias exactly like server/ does.
